design_review: The batch diagnoses existing B1 weaknesses and rejected grouped-C failures without changing adoption thresholds or assigning a new initialization/model rule.
Pointwise temporal amount sums are kept distinct from aggregate event gain/loss totals.
Controls are constrained by observed band and deterministic nearest-unused matching; matching is not asserted to make physical conditions identical.
The state protocol remains a separate gate before extraction; temperature/RH are diagnostics and invalid Dm remains undefined.
limits: GO applies only to the frozen analysis plan and arithmetic from the prior six-hour score bundle.
It does not authorize or review the separate state extraction protocol/implementation.
It does not establish physical mechanism, causation, flux closure, runtime validation, or forecast adoption.
